ftbteamsconfig.chunk_restrictor.tooltip: This mod prevent players from accessing specific chunks using Chunk Coordinates, which are different from the world coordinates
ftbteamsconfig.chunk_restrictor.claim_ac: Default access if no other property kicks in
Should enemies be able to enter the claims? UNLESS another property allow them
These usernames will never be able to enter your claims
ftbteamsconfig.chunk_restrictor.chunk_ac:
Allow these chunks to be accessed by everyone unless another property prevent them

Simply put the X and Z values of a chunk and separate them with a space. For example in your F3 you will see something like "Chunk: 1 y -7 [10 -10 in r.1.1.mca]" - in this specific example you need to add "1 -7" NOT THE Y AND PUT A SPACE

Allow these chunks to be accessed ONLY by allies unless another property prevent them

Simply put the X and Z values of a chunk and separate them with a space. For example in your F3 you will see something like "Chunk: 1 y -7 [10 -10 in r.1.1.mca]" - in this specific example you need to add "1 -7" NOT THE Y AND PUT A SPACE

Allow these chunks to be accessed ONLY by members unless another property prevent them

Simply put the X and Z values of a chunk and separate them with a space. For example in your F3 you will see something like "Chunk: 1 y -7 [10 -10 in r.1.1.mca]" - in this specific example you need to add "1 -7" NOT THE Y AND PUT A SPACE

Allow these chunks to be accessed ONLY by officers unless another property prevent them

Simply put the X and Z values of a chunk and separate them with a space. For example in your F3 you will see something like "Chunk: 1 y -7 [10 -10 in r.1.1.mca]" - in this specific example you need to add "1 -7" NOT THE Y AND PUT A SPACE

This is working the same way as the previous "Chunks" values but using a custom permission called "Admins". This permission can be given by putting the username into the "Admins" property. This property will not automatically give access to all chunks in the claim, only to admin chunks
